subject: Re: VPC / Private deployment interest — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@finsecure.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: VPC / Private deployment interest — next steps

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciated the deep dive on FinSecure's latency and data residency requirements. Per our call, I wanted to recap the items we discussed and propose clear next steps so we can keep momentum.

Summary of what I heard:
- Primary drivers: PII handling requirements, SOC2 audit next quarter, and sub-30ms p50 inference latency for core risk models.
- Preferred deployment: private VPC in their cloud account (customer-managed networking) to satisfy residency + key management controls.
- Timeline: procurement kicked off by end of Q3, target pilot before year-end.

Attachments: I’m attaching a short VPC overview (Redwood-VPC-Overview.pdf) and a one-page checklist for the procurement team.

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll share a draft mutual action plan (MAP) this week that maps security artifacts (SOC2 audit report, network diagrams, KMS support) to procurement milestones.
2) If helpful, we can schedule a technical design session with our Private deployment engineer (Jonas) to review networking and routing options.
3) You confirm the list of stakeholders who need the SOC2 evidence and the estimated procurement approval date.

Would Thursday at 10am PT work for a 30-min technical sync? Happy to adjust.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

---
Redwood-VPC-Overview.pdf (attached) — 3 pages
FinSecure-MAP-worksheet.xlsx (attached) — 1 sheet

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the recap and for the materials — I shared them with our security and procurement leads. Thursday at 10am PT should work for a technical sync; I’ve tentatively booked it.

Two quick notes from security:

- Also requested an example network diagram showing routing for private subnets and any egress controls.

I’ll introduce our Head of Security, Amit Desai, on the calendar invite.

Best,
